notes.title: Pussy Clicker Is Here!
notes.content:
Gooners and Goonettes,
Rejoice as the time has finally come. Pussy Clicker 1.0 is now available. I hope you all enjoy. Please leave any feedback and bug reports as this is just the beginning of the journey for this game. There is more to come in the future, stay tuned.
